notes.title: Jump into Chomp City Arena and be the LAST PAC STANDING!
notes.content:
Everything except the maze is edible in PAC-MAN MEGA TUNNEL BATTLE: CHOMP CHAMPS, where players chomp their way through pellets, power-ups, GHOSTS, and even other PACs across multiple interconnected mazes to become the Chomp Champ – a.k.a. the last PAC standing at the end of each match. 

[previewyoutube=hCym2OJrF08;full][/previewyoutube]

Available now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095950/PACMAN_Mega_Tunnel_Battle_Chomp_Champs/

notes.title: Chomp everything in sight in PAC-MAN MEGA TUNNEL BATTLE: CHOMP CHAMPS
notes.content:
PAC-MAN MEGA TUNNEL BATTLE: CHOMP CHAMPS is a raucous take on PAC-MAN multiplayer, featuring cross-play for the first time and amping up gameplay with:
 64-player battles
A variety of colourful interconnected mazes
Customizable PACs
Power Items that not only boost players’ abilities...
...but can also help the GHOSTS chase down the competition
The game is available now for preorder in Standard and Deluxe editions, with all preorders receiving the Chomp Challengers Pac Preorder bonus

[previewyoutube=7J089XoFDfE;full][/previewyoutube]

Coming May 9th, 2024 on Steam!
